messages:
samir: Hi team — doing a POC with NovaHealth. They need a POC billing/project setup + hosted API keys + option for dedicated pool later. Can we provision a trial org and set a spend cap of $10k? Need ephemeral keys for devs. Any blockers?

liz-sales: Thanks! Main asks: 1) trial org + billing project 2) spend cap/soft quota 3) ephemeral API keys for up to 6 devs 4) ability to upgrade to Dedicated pool mid-POC. timeline = 2 weeks. :calendar:

maria-devex: I can do the org/project provisioning. Question: do we want all devs under one project or separate projects per team? For auditing, we usually recommend one project per team.

samir: one project for core team, separate project for data-science. Also need token-level cost visibility for the POC.

chris-eng: Dedicated prewarm is fine but we need an internal approved capacity for the POC. For now create hosted keys that route to hosted API but allow fallback to a small dedicated pool when we flip the flag.

olivia-security: They asked about VPC gating and IP allowlist. For hosted POC, we can do IP allowlist + mTLS for the dedicated option. Need to confirm legal for ephemeral keys storing.

maria-devex: provisioning steps I'll run: 
```
# create trial org and default billing project
redwoodctl org create --name "novahealth-poc" --trial-credits 10000 --owner liz-sales@nova.com
redwoodctl project create --org novahealth-poc --name core-team --quota-tokens 2000000 --spend-cap 10000
# generate ephemeral keys (TTL 14d)
redwoodctl api-keys create --project core-team --type ephemeral --count 6 --ttl 14d
```

provision-bot: Provision started for org novahealth-poc. Estimated time: 7m. Request ID: req_0x9b7c

liz-sales: Can we set the spend cap to be a soft cap (email + webhook on breach) instead of hard block? Customer prefers soft first.

maria-devex: Yes — default is soft alert + disable keys action if opted-in. I'll enable alerts and webhook to their FINOPS Slack.

chris-eng: For Dedicated routing we need to create a pool and pre-assign 1xA100-equivalent for canary. That requires a reserved capacity approval. @liz-sales can you confirm they accept a one-month reserved minimum if we enable? 

liz-sales: I'll confirm. Likely yes if we prove latency and cost numbers in the POC.

olivia-security: Also recording: need KMS integration for private deployment later. For hosted trial ensure logs scrub PII and we have retention settings set to 30 days.

samir: Great. Maria — please run the provisioning and post the ephemeral keys to an encrypted channel. cc @chris-eng for the dedicated plan.

maria-devex: Done. Keys generated and sent via Vault link. Also set webhook for spend alerts to their FinOps Slack channel. Provision-bot says provisioning complete.

provision-bot: Provision complete. org=novahealth-poc projects=[core-team,data-science] keys=6 ephemeral keys created. spend_cap=10000 alerts=enabled

samir: Thanks everyone. Next action: liz to confirm reserved capacity acceptance within 48h, olivia to inline security checklist for POC, chris to draft dedicated pool sizing. I'll update the deal doc.

liz-sales: On it. Will update by EOD.

olivia-security: I'll DM the checklist and attach to the POC JIRA.

chris-eng: I'll post sizing options in the eng channel tomorrow.

samir: closing loop — marking this thread resolved for now :white_check_mark:
